# STROBE checklist

Study type: Cross-sectional secondary analysis of KDHS 2022 (women's and men's recodes).

| 1 | Study design in title and abstract | Title; Abstract |
| 2 | Background and rationale | Background |
| 3 | Objectives | End of Background |
| 4 | Study design | Methods |
| 5 | Setting and dates | Methods |
| 6 | Participants / eligibility | Methods |
| 7 | Variables (outcome, exposures, covariates) | Methods |
| 8 | Data sources and measurement | Methods |
| 9 | Bias | Discussion: limitations |
| 10 | Study size | Methods; Results |
| 11 | Quantitative variables | Methods |
| 12 | Statistical methods | Methods |
| 13 | Participants / flow | Methods; Results |
| 14 | Descriptive data | Results; Table 1 |
| 15 | Outcome data | Results; Tables 1-2; Figure 1 |
| 16 | Main results (adjusted) | Results; Table 3 |
| 17 | Other analyses (subgroups, concentration index) | Results; Table 2 |
| 18 | Key results | Discussion |
| 19 | Limitations | Discussion |
| 20 | Interpretation | Discussion |
